name.text: Incircle radius of a right triangle (INNODEMS)

questiontext.text:
The right-angled triangle below (right angle at \(C\)) has sides \(a = {@sa@}\) cm, \(b = {@sb@}\) cm and \(c = {@sc@}\) cm.

Its inscribed circle (centre \(I\), in blue) is the circle inside the triangle that touches all three sides. Find its radius, in centimetres.

[[jsxgraph width='430px' height='430px']] var Ax=0, Ay={#sb#}, Bx={#sa#}, By=0, Cx=0, Cy=0; // right angle at C var la=Math.hypot(Bx-Cx,By-Cy), lb=Math.hypot(Ax-Cx,Ay-Cy), lc=Math.hypot(Ax-Bx,Ay-By); var per=la+lb+lc; var area=Math.abs((Bx-Ax)*(Cy-Ay)-(Cx-Ax)*(By-Ay))/2, r=area/(per/2); var Ix=(la*Ax+lb*Bx+lc*Cx)/per, Iy=(la*Ay+lb*By+lc*Cy)/per; var xs=[Ax,Bx,Cx,Ix-r,Ix+r], ys=[Ay,By,Cy,Iy-r,Iy+r]; var xmin=Math.min.apply(null,xs),xmax=Math.max.apply(null,xs),ymin=Math.min.apply(null,ys),ymax=Math.max.apply(null,ys); var pX=0.16*(xmax-xmin),pY=0.16*(ymax-ymin); var board=JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid,{boundingbox:[xmin-pX,ymax+pY,xmax+pX,ymin-pY], keepaspectratio:true,axis:false,showCopyright:false,showNavigation:false,pan:{enabled:false},zoom:{enabled:false}}); var A=board.create('point',[Ax,Ay],{fixed:true,highlight:false,name:'A',size:2,label:{offset:[-12,4]}}); var B=board.create('point',[Bx,By],{fixed:true,highlight:false,name:'B',size:2,label:{offset:[10,-8]}}); var C=board.create('point',[Cx,Cy],{fixed:true,highlight:false,name:'C',size:2,label:{offset:[-12,-10]}}); board.create('polygon',[A,B,C],{fixed:true,highlight:false,fillColor:'#e3f2fd',fillOpacity:0.5, borders:{strokeColor:'#222',strokeWidth:2,highlight:false,fixed:true},vertices:{visible:false}}); board.create('angle',[A,C,B],{type:'square',radius:Math.min(la,lb)*0.16,fixed:true,highlight:false, label:{visible:false}}); board.create('circle',[[Ix,Iy],r],{strokeColor:'#1565c0',strokeWidth:1.5,fillColor:'none',fixed:true,highlight:false}); board.create('point',[Ix,Iy],{fixed:true,highlight:false,name:'I',size:1,strokeColor:'#1565c0',fillColor:'#1565c0',label:{offset:[6,-2]}}); var sl={fixed:true,highlight:false,fontSize:15,anchorX:'middle',anchorY:'middle'}; var dx=0.07*(xmax-xmin),dy=0.07*(ymax-ymin); board.create('text',[(Bx+Cx)/2,(By+Cy)/2-dy,{#sa#}],sl); board.create('text',[(Cx+Ax)/2-dx,(Cy+Ay)/2,{#sb#}],sl); board.create('text',[(Ax+Bx)/2+2*dx,(Ay+By)/2+2*dy,{#sc#}],sl); [[/jsxgraph]]
Radius of the inscribed circle: \(r = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] cm [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
The inradius is the area divided by the semi-perimeter, \(r=\Delta/s\). With \(a={@sa@}\), \(b={@sb@}\), \(c={@sc@}\) (the legs are \(a\) and \(b\)):

\[ s = \frac{a+b+c}{2} = {@ssemi@}, \qquad \Delta = \tfrac12 a b = {@area@}, \qquad r = \frac{\Delta}{s} = \frac{{@area@}}{{@ssemi@}} = {@rin@}\text{ cm}. \]

For a right triangle there is a useful shortcut that gives the same value: \( r = \dfrac{a+b-c}{2} = \dfrac{{@sa@}+{@sb@}-{@sc@}}{2} = {@rin@}\) cm.

truefeedback.text: That is twice the inradius — it looks like the diameter. The question asks for the radius, which is half of that.

node.description: Diagnose: gave the area; else generic

truefeedback.text: That is the area \(\Delta\) of the triangle. The inradius still needs you to divide by the semi-perimeter: \(r=\Delta/s\).

falsefeedback.text: Not correct. Find the area \(\Delta\) and the semi-perimeter \(s=(a+b+c)/2\), then use \(r=\Delta/s\).
